name: QWEN-MODEL1-TREE
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-MODEL1-TREE + amendments -LOGIC, -METRIC, -PRIORS, -PINS, -KFENCE (refinement CLOSED in -KFENCE). Registered numbers unchanged: 20% relative CE+KL conjunction, 5x fp16_record_sensitivity_floor fence, X_A > 1.0 uniform-damage alarm, single-digit-nats alignment precondition. Each material-improvement step is three bars (X-relative, K-relative, X-delta floor multiple) that must ALL fire; scripts/qwen_tree_walk.py maps bar outcomes to branch T1/T2/T3/T4/NONMONOTONIC/ALARM with zero discretion, in the -LOGIC evaluation order. Two projection resolutions, both fenced conservative: (a) the anomaly gate's 'either or both metrics' OR is encoded as anomaly_condition_count (count of reversed-direction 20%+floor conditions among B-v-A and C-v-B on X and K; any nonzero count books NONMONOTONIC); (b) the K-side degradation conditions use f_K (the -KFENCE floor) symmetrically with f_X; (c) the -METRIC(8) round-trip re-encode fixture is substituted by a decode-v-vendor relative-L2 oracle (refuse > 0.5) plus rows-decoder-v-canonical bit-identity — the frozen encoders train per-tensor on the compile device and cross-device codebook bit-identity is not a registered property; the substituted oracle catches the same defect class (nibble order, codebook offset, exponent bias) at zero model cost. Degenerate X_Z <= 0 books via contrasts inadmissibility -> UNRESOLVED, per the registered stop-for-review rule. All X/K from the Mac CPU reference leg only (device rule -METRIC 6).

A.description: uniform-2 W4-everywhere artifact (WHOLE-0T arm A, 6.50 GiB)

B.description: guarded-io: A plus embed_tokens + lm_head at S16 (WHOLE-0T arm B, 7.09 GiB)

C.description: conservative: B plus all attention projections at S16 (WHOLE-0T arm C, 8.77 GiB)

bars.name: ALIGN-SANITY
bars.description: -METRIC (3) admissibility precondition: CE_teacher recomputed from the locked records on the logits[:-1] v ids[1:] alignment lands in single-digit nats; the misaligned pairing sits near log(V) ~ 12.4 and books INSTRUMENT-ALARM, never a score

bars.name: UNIFORM-DAMAGE-CLEAN
bars.description: -METRIC (5): X_A <= 1.0 nat or INSTRUMENT-ALARM — no branch may fire on a catastrophically damaged best arm

bars.name: ANOMALY-CLEAN
bars.description: -LOGIC (2) anomaly gate: count of material-degradation conditions (B worse than A, C worse than B; 20% reversed conjunction legs on X or K, each past its 5x floor) must be zero, else NONMONOTONIC/UNRESOLVED

bars.name: T1K-B-OVER-A
bars.description: (K_A - K_B) / K_A >= 0.20, forward KL(teacher||arm), live vocab

refuted_if: The registered house prior (the curve lands in the T1 branch: B materially improves A, C adds little over B) is REFUTED if the mechanical walker lands any branch other than T1 on clean gates. Separately, any gate alarm (bars 1-3) books INSTRUMENT-ALARM or NONMONOTONIC and no allocation claim exists.
registered_prior: House, confidence weak/medium (lowered by -TREE-PRIORS 2): T1 fires — B materially improves over A on semantic-role grounds (embeddings and lm_head directly define token geometry), C adds little over B. Conditional prior if T1 fires and D/E are built: D (embed repaired) > E (head repaired) per STAR-PROFILE lineage, adjudicated by the -PINS recovery-fraction metric with the -KFENCE symmetric floors.
